description: Source code implementing functions for parsing and converting X.509 distinguished names, including OID to string conversion, attribute value extraction, and RFC2253 string formatting.

classes.name: X509NameAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute in an X.509 distinguished name, with methods to convert its value to string and format as RFC2253 string.

methods.name: OidToString
methods.description: Converts an OID input to its dotted string representation.

methods.name: X509NameAttribute::ValueAsString
methods.description: Returns the attribute value as a string, handling various string types.

methods.name: X509NameAttribute::ValueAsStringWithUnsafeOptions
methods.description: Returns the attribute value as a string with options for handling printable strings.

methods.name: X509NameAttribute::ValueAsStringUnsafe
methods.description: Returns the attribute value as a string without safety checks.

methods.name: X509NameAttribute::AsRFC2253String
methods.description: Formats the attribute as an RFC2253 string.

methods.name: ReadRdn
methods.description: Reads a RelativeDistinguishedName from a DER parser.

methods.name: ParseName
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded name into a sequence of RDNs.

methods.name: ParseNameValue
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded name value into RDNs.

methods.name: ConvertToRFC2253
methods.description: Converts an RDN sequence into an RFC2253 formatted string.
